# Opposition insight for Milan-Bologna: Form, injuries, predicted XI and more

By Ben Dixon -

Photo by Maurizio Lagana + Emmanuele Ciancaglini/Getty Image

Bologna are the next visitors to San Siro, as AC Milan hope to respond to last week’s Europa League loss with six points out of six. [...] It’s been a difficult October for Milan, but they are almost at the end point. The defeat to Bournemouth in the Europa League last Thursday risked something of a collapse. Yet, a 2-0 win in Udine at the weekend has halted those fears.

data.content:
Advertisement

Following their victory over Fiorentina, Inter are preparing for the first midweek round of the season. The Nerazzurri will take to the pitch on Wednesday 28 October at 18:30 CET away to Venezia. The fixture, part of matchday nine in the Serie A, will see Chivu's side face Davide Nicola's orange-and-black team, who head into the match following a defeat to Genoa at the Marassi.
